title: Reduction in the cash Individual Savings Account (ISA) limit
text:
This tax information and impact note explains changes to the Individual Savings Account Regulations 1998 to reduce the annual cash ISA subscription limit to £12,000 for individuals aged under 65 from 6 April 2027.

 It also introduces changes and rules to make sure the limits operate as intended.
